provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.syntax.anchors.identity against rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:roles, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:chapter_roles, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:process_with_roots, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:relative_html, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:render_role, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:indexes_forward_references_and_nested_chapters, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:cross_references_traverse_to_parent_and_bad_references_fail, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:literal_examples_are_not_anchors, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:typed_anchor_roles_share_ids_and_references_without_implying_proofs. roles validates the documented ASCII ID shape and excludes literal contexts; chapter_roles adds structured IDs to the shared namespace; process_with_roots indexes all chapters before rendering and rejects duplicates. relative_html and render_role build local/relative shield links. Tests cover forward/nested/parent references, missing/duplicate IDs, literal examples and neutral/definition role labels without proof implications. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
